title: Protective coatings and wrapping.
officialText:
Pipe protective coatings and wrappings shall be approved for the application and shall
be factory applied.
Exception: Where installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s installation instructions, field application of coatings and
wrappings shall be permitted for pipe nipples, fittings and locations where the factory coating or wrapping has been damaged or
necessarily removed at joints.
